caption: The drawing features a single ornate teapot rendered in shades of gray pencil on a cream-colored background. The teapot is shown in profile, revealing a tall, gently sloping spout on the right and a large, curved handle on the left, both decorated with shaded lines to indicate their cylindrical form. The body of the teapot is rectangular with beveled edges, and two distinct decorative horizontal bands adorned with a floral and geometric motif encircle both the upper and lower portions of the vessel. The lid, crowned with a rounded finial, rises in an elegant curve from the center and matches the rest of the vessel in ornamentation. At the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, separate ellipse labeled “TOP DETAIL,” showing a top-down view of the teapot’s lid, with a central knob and the same decorative edging. The overall composition is balanced with fine, precise line work and subtle shading emphasizing the metallic texture and three-dimensionality of the teapot.
title: Silver Teapot
